389:t_2:29.en:
$$レド$$
「After the lieutenant colonel died, his $$マシンキャリバー$$, $$ストライカー#pilot$$, took over the plan.」

389:t_2:30.en:
$$タケル$$
「Is it a $$パイロット支援啓発インターフェイス$$, like $$チェインバー#pilot$$?」

389:t_2:31.en:
$$レド$$
「It called itself a $$人類支援啓蒙レギュレーションシステム$$... A being known as God.」

389:t_2:34.en:
$$レド$$
「So I fought it alongside $$チェインバー#pilot$$. By my own choice.」

389:t_2:35.en:
$$アルト$$
「The $$ギャラクシー船団$$ intervened in that battle against $$ストライカー#pilot$$.」

389:t_2:36.en:
$$甲児$$
「So those guys... were still alive after all...」

389:t_2:37.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「We thrashed them in the $$再世戦争$$, but they just don't learn.」

389:t_2:38.en:
$$アルト$$
「But apparently, they've developed a way to control the $$バジュラ$$.」

389:t_2:40.en:
$$アルト$$
「Those differently colored $$バジュラ$$ we fought at the center of the galaxy were under the $$ギャラクシー船団$$'s control.」

389:t_2:41.en:
$$アルト$$
「They took control of $$ブレラ$$ again and attacked us.」

389:t_2:42.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What happened to $$ブレラ$$, then?」

389:t_2:43.en:
$$アルト$$
「Don't worry. The receiver system inside his body was destroyed, so they'll never be able to control him again.」

389:t_2:44.en:
$$レド$$
「Then $$ストライカー#pilot$$ joined up with forces believed to belong to the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ and left.」

389:t_2:45.en:
$$宗介$$
「So your battle against it isn't over yet.」

389:t_2:47.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You seem... different from before, $$レド$$.」

389:t_2:48.en:
$$勝平$$
「Did you stop being the quiet type?」

389:t_2:49.en:
$$レド$$
「...Until now, I think part of me was trapped by my identity as a soldier of the $$人類銀河同盟$$.」

389:t_2:50.en:
$$レド$$
「That was probably why I attacked the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$... the $$クジライカ$$.」

389:t_2:51.en:
$$宗介$$
「And you've broken free of that?」

389:t_2:52.en:
$$レド$$
「Through the battle with Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$... with $$ストライカー#pilot$$, I learned what I fight for and what I want to protect.」

389:t_2:53.en:
$$レド$$
「I may be a failure as a soldier. But I want to live as a human being.」

389:t_2:54.en:
$$アルト$$
「And it seems $$チェインバー#pilot$$ will support $$レド$$ in that.」

389:t_2:55.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「It's powered up too, with equipment I repaired from the treasure we found!」

389:t_2:56.en:
$$アルト$$
「While we're on the subject, $$ラケージ$$, that pirate woman from the $$残されの海$$, is coming with us too.」

389:t_2:57.en:
$$甲児$$
「The woman in that lobster-shaped $$ユンボロ$$?」

389:t_2:58.en:
$$レド$$
「Apparently, she's taken a liking to $$ピニオン$$.」

389:t_2:59.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「D-don't go telling them that, $$レド$$!」

389:t_2:61.en:
$$勝平$$
「I don't really get the stuff about being human, but you look a lot happier to be alive now, Big Bro $$レド$$.」

389:t_2:62.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Maybe that's the power of $$エイミー$$'s love too.」

389:t_2:63.en:
$$レド$$
「I don't really understand love, but I do want to live with $$エイミー$$.」

389:t_2:64.en:
$$甲児$$
「Well, that was a sweet treat.」

389:t_2:66.en:
$$タケル$$
「You still have a lot to learn.」

389:t_2:67.en:
$$宗介$$
「But let me welcome you again, $$レド$$. You're one of $c.」

389:t_2:69.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Still, I'm surprised. I never knew $$ランド$$ had worries and fears.」

389:t_2:70.en:
$$ランド$$
「Adults don't show that stuff on the surface.」

389:t_2:71.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Maybe you're right. $$ジャミル$$ was like that too.」

389:t_2:72.en:
$$クロウ$$
「But put adults in the same boat together, and it turns into a gripe session in no time.」

389:t_2:73.en:
$$ランド$$
「Well... We all need to blow off steam.」

389:t_2:74.en:
$$メール$$
「What are you talking about, Darling!? You guzzle so much beer to blow off steam that our business is always in the red!」

389:t_2:75.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't get so mad, $$メール$$. If you keep harping on the money, poor $$ランド$$ won't get a break.」

389:t_2:77.en:
$n
「If it keeps $$ランド$$ smiling, you've got to put up with a little expense.」

389:t_2:78.en:
$$メール$$
「That's unfair! You're trying to talk me into it, four against one!」

389:t_2:79.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「What a lovely display of mutual support among Reactors.」

389:t_2:80.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「It means they're all on the same level.」

389:t_2:82.en:
$$クロウ$$
「No need to thank us. You showed us how to break through a wall.」

389:t_2:84.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Yes... I feel that same indescribable anxiety you and $n feel, $$ランド$$.」

389:t_2:85.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That seems to be why the final door to our machines' power won't open.」

389:t_2:86.en:
$$ランド$$
「So it's an illness unique to Reactors?」

389:t_2:87.en:
$$クロウ$$
「As if fearing the backlash wasn't enough, we get this too. You're giving us way too many extras, Mr. $$スフィア$$...」

389:t_2:91.en:
$n
「I was just thinking I'd follow $$ランド$$'s example and do my best.」

389:t_2:92.en:
$$ランド$$
「That's the spirit, young man! You follow the road to manhood too!」

389:t_2:94.en:
$n
(If this anxiety is unique to Reactors, what was Miss $$スズネ$$ afraid of...?)

389:t_2:95.en:
$n
(Could it have something to do with her no longer feeling anxious just before she was abducted...?)

389:t_10:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...What the hell is with that $$エルーナルーナ$$ woman...?」

389:t_10:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We never could have imagined it when she was covered in armor.」

389:t_10:5.en:
$n
「No matter how good a commander she is, I can understand people deciding they don't want her heading the military...」

389:t_10:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I actually sympathized with Emperor $$アウストラリス$$ a little.」

389:t_10:7.en:
$n
「I feel sorry for $$ランド$$. He's going to have her following him around.」

389:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Well, everyone, $$エルーナルーナ$$'s appearance seems to have brought up a lot for you, but it certainly stirred all your hearts.」

389:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That generated 100 Z worth of Z-Chips! I'll add them to the team's stock.」

389:t_10:12.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$ＡＧ$$, if we took off your armor, would there be someone inside too...? There wouldn't, right?」

389:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How naughty~. So you're thinking about stripping off my armor, are you?」

389:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm sorry to disappoint you, but I am merely a robot...」
